setup.title: Welcome to FamQuest
setup.intro: Set up your family in two quick steps.
setup.pin_intro: The parent PIN protects the parent area so children don't change anything by accident.

demo.title: Try FamQuest
demo.intro: Meet the Berger family, a sample family. Feel free to tap, tick off and change anything.
demo.reset_hourly: Everything is reset on the hour.

kitchen.title: Kitchen view
kitchen.hint: For a small tablet in the kitchen (landscape): the next days with events and meals, swipe for tasks, household and shopping. No navigation bar; on the tablet, best set the address {{path}} as the start page.

family.no_members_hint: You can add your family in the parents' area.
family.no_children_hint: In the parents' area you can add children with their tasks and set up the cleaning plan for the household.

parents.title: Parent area
parents.reset_intro: Enter your account password, then choose a new PIN.
parents.pin_on: The PIN protects the parent area.
parents.pin_off: The parent area is not protected. Anyone can open it.
parents.disable_confirm: Really turn off the PIN? Anyone will be able to open the parent area.
parents.pin_saved: The new PIN has been saved.

members.empty: Nobody added yet. Start by adding everyone in your family.
members.all_colors_taken: All colours are in use. No more people can be added.
members.name: Name
members.delete_confirm: Really delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
members.order_hint: Use the arrows (or drag with the mouse) to set the order in which people appear everywhere.
members.event_symbols_hint: Events in the calendar get symbols (see "Calendar & weather"). For children who can't read yet; just switch it off for older ones.

cropper.title: Choose image area
cropper.hint: Drag and zoom until the face is inside the circle.
cropper.hint_rect: Drag and zoom until the dish fills the picture nicely.

tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Add your first one, for example brushing teeth.
tasks.need_members: Add children under “Family” first, then you can give them tasks.
tasks.title: Title
tasks.active_hint: Inactive tasks don't appear in the family view.
tasks.delete_confirm: Really delete “{{title}}”? This can't be undone. If you only want to pause it, set it to inactive.
tasks.needs_approval_hint: Points are only given once you confirm it in the parents' area.
tasks.flexible_hint: No fixed day: the task shows up when it's due and stays until it's done. After that it's due again after this time.
tasks.shared_hint: Whoever does the task does it for everyone selected. The points go to that person.
tasks.extra_hint: Extra: optional, shown in its own "Extras" block. Earns points but doesn't count towards the daily progress.
tasks.routine_hint: The tasks of one time of day form a routine. You set their order in the "Routines" section.
tasks.order_hint: This is how {{name}} sees the tasks on the display. You set the order of the routines in the "Routines" section.
tasks.kids_only: Tasks are for the children. Household chores live in the cleaning plan:

routines.intro: For each child: morning, afternoon and evening as a fixed sequence of steps. With "Different on other days" the weekend, for example, gets its own shorter version.
routines.need_children: Add a child first, then you can put together their routines.
routines.label: {{name}} · {{time}} · {{days}}
routines.copy_hint: Who else should this routine ({{days}}) apply to? On these days it replaces that child's current routine.
routines.delete_confirm: Really delete {{routine}}? The tasks themselves are kept.
routines.task_in_routines: Step in the {{time}} routine of {{names}}. The routine decides on which days it is due.

icon_picker.title: Choose an icon
icon_picker.no_results: No icon found. Try another word.

points.need_members: Once you have family members, their points will show up here.
points.direction: What would you like to do?
points.reason_hint: For example: Helped set the table

validation.invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address
validation.invalid_choice: Please pick one of the options
validation.choose_member: Please choose at least one person
validation.choose_weekday: Please choose at least one day
validation.not_zero: Please enter a number greater than 0

auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
auth.csrf_failed: Security check failed. Please reload the page.

setup.required: The app has not been set up yet

pin.mismatch: The PINs don't match. Please try again.

parent.locked: The parent area is locked. Please enter the PIN.

member.color_taken: This colour is already taken. Please pick another one.
member.order_invalid: The order doesn't match the family members. Please reload.
member.has_tasks: This person still has tasks or routines, and those exist for children only. Remove them first, then the role can be changed.

avatar.too_large: The image is too large (5 MB max)
avatar.invalid_image: The image could not be read. Please choose another photo.

task.in_routine: This task is a step in a routine. Its time of day and "Extra" can't be changed here.
task.child_only: Tasks are for children only. Household chores for adults live in the cleaning plan under “Household”.

routine.not_found: This routine no longer exists. Please reload.
routine.step_invalid: This step doesn't fit the routine. Please reload.

completion.day_changed: A new day has started. The tasks have been updated.

points.insufficient: There aren't enough points for that.

reward.inactive: This reward is not available right now

approval.not_found: This has already been checked or undone.

calendar.not_configured: Google Calendar is not set up yet
calendar.state_invalid: The Google sign-in expired or is invalid. Please try again.
calendar.scope_missing: Calendar access was not allowed. Please connect again and tick calendar access.
calendar.reconnect: Access to the Google account has expired. Please reconnect.
calendar.google_unreachable: Google can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
calendar.google_failed: Google rejected the request. Please try again later.
calendar.client_invalid: Google doesn't recognise the credentials. Please check GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.
calendar.rate_limited: Google is slowing down requests right now. It will continue on its own shortly.
calendar.calendar_unavailable: This calendar is no longer available at Google

weather.unavailable: The weather is not available right now

home.invalid_layout: This start page layout is invalid

photo.too_large: The photo is too large (25 MB max).
photo.invalid_image: The photo could not be read. JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.

dish.duplicate_name: There is already a dish with this name.
dish.planned: This dish is still in the plan. Remove it there first.
dish.invalid_image: The photo couldn't be read. Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
dish.image_too_large: The photo is too large (5 MB at most).

shopping.not_on_list: This item is no longer on the list.
shopping.duplicate_name: There is already an item with this name.

demo.resetting: The demo is being reset right now. Please try again in a moment.

chore.room_duplicate: There is already a room with this name.
chore.counted_from_future: This day is in the future.

todo.duplicate: That is already on the list.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.no_children: Rewards are for children. Add a child in the parents' area.
rewards.none_yet: No rewards yet. Mum or Dad can pick some.
rewards.need_children: Rewards are only for children. Add a child first.
rewards.empty: {{name}} has no rewards yet. Pick some from the suggestions.
rewards.name: Name
rewards.active_hint: Inactive rewards are hidden on the display.
rewards.delete_confirm: Really delete “{{name}}”? Past redemptions stay in the history.
rewards.pool_intro: Tap every reward that fits. You can change cost and name afterwards.

approvals.intro: These tasks were tapped as done. If it's all good, the points are added.

family_settings.name: Family name
family_settings.language_hint: Applies on every device where nobody has picked a language.
family_settings.timezone_hint: Decides when a new day starts.
family_settings.saved: The family settings have been saved.

device.size_hint: Applies only to this device, e.g. smaller on a tablet or larger on a wall display. The size also adapts automatically to the screen height.
device.info: Display: {{width}} × {{height}} px, scaling {{ratio}}, base font {{font}} px
device.frame_idle_hint: Applies to this device only. If nobody touches the display for this long, it shows the photos. A tap goes back to “Today”. On a phone, “Off” is best.

calendar.intro: Connect a Google account so FamQuest can show your events. FamQuest only reads the calendars and never changes them.
calendar.not_configured: Google Calendar is not set up yet. The configuration (.env) needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET and TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY. See the README for instructions.
calendar.disconnect_confirm: Really disconnect {{email}}? Events from this account will no longer be shown.
calendar.redirect_uri: Redirect URI for the Google Cloud Console:
calendar.calendars: Which calendars should appear on the display, and who do they belong to?
calendar.no_calendars: There are no calendars in this account.
calendar.family_color_hint: For events that belong to everyone.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.problem: The calendar isn't updating right now. See the parent area for details.
calendar.nothing_selected_hint: In the parent area under “Calendar”, connect a Google account and choose calendars.
calendar.holidays_intro: Shows public holidays and school holidays of your German state in the calendar, even without a Google account.

home.customize_hint: Switch sections on or off. You can see the result right below. Applies to the whole family.
home.no_children: You can add children in the parents' area.
home.week_rolling_hint: Today always comes first, then the next six days.
home.week_monday_hint: Like a weekly planner: Monday first, Sunday last.
home.chores_setup: No cleaning plan yet. The assistant in the parents' area makes suggestions.

weather.stale: No connection to the weather service right now; this is the last forecast.

weather_settings.intro: The start page shows the weather for your town. The forecast comes from Open-Meteo; only the town's coordinates are sent.
weather_settings.search_hint: Name of the town or postcode, then pick it from the list.

photos.hint: The picture frame on the display shows these photos. Hidden photos stay saved but are not shown. Photos are scaled down when uploaded; location and other metadata are removed.
photos.empty: No photos yet. Tap “Add photos”; on a phone you can pick them straight from the gallery.

frame.exit: Close the picture frame and go back to “Today”
frame.empty: No photos yet. You can upload some in the parent area under “Photos”.
frame.settings_hint: Applies to the whole family. The overlays appear at the bottom of the photos.
frame.night_hint: At night the picture frame shows no photos. The display itself stays on, see the README.

meals.title: Meal plan
meals.no_suggestions: No suggestion fits. "Save" adds "{{name}}" as a new dish.
meals.settings_hint: Which meals you plan. Applies to the whole family.
meals.picture_hint: Your own photo replaces the icon everywhere, including on the display.
meals.delete_confirm: Really delete "{{name}}"? It disappears from the suggestions and from past weeks.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.no_suggestions: No suggestion fits. "Add" puts "{{name}}" on the list as a new item.
shopping.delete_confirm: Really delete "{{name}}"? It disappears from the suggestions and from the list.
shopping.empty_hint: Need something? Tap here to add it.

event_symbols.intro: If one of these words is in an event's title, the calendar shows its symbol. That way children recognise their events without reading. "Swim" also matches "Swimming lesson"; short words (up to three letters) like "gym" only as a whole word.
event_symbols.for_nobody: Not switched on for anyone yet. Under "Family", edit the person and switch on "Symbols for events".
event_symbols.suggestions_intro: Tap what happens in your family. You can change the words afterwards.
event_symbols.terms_hint: Separate with commas, e.g. "Judo, karate, martial arts"

chores.title: Household
chores.empty_hint: Tap here to set it up in the parents' area. The assistant makes suggestions.
chores.all_good: All good. Nothing is due right now.
chores.section_empty: There are no rooms yet. The assistant asks a few questions about your home and suggests rooms, chores and intervals.
chores.section_intro: Every chore has its own interval; the traffic light in the “Household” view shows what is due. The assistant adds more suggestions without changing what is already there.
chores.room_empty: There are no chores in this room yet.
chores.delete_room_confirm_one: Really delete “{{name}}”? The chore in it will be deleted too.
chores.delete_room_confirm_other: Really delete “{{name}}”? The {{count}} chores in it will be deleted too.
chores.interval_hint: Due {{interval}}, counted from the last time it was done, not on a fixed date.
chores.state: What is the state right now?
chores.counted_from_hint: For example: windows cleaned ten weeks ago. The interval counts from this day.
chores.counted_from_removes: Completions ticked off after this day will be removed.
chores.active_hint: Paused chores do not appear in the “Household” view.
chores.delete_confirm: Really delete “{{title}}”? This cannot be undone. If you only want to pause it, switch it off.
chores.wizard_intro: A few questions about your home turn into a suggestion. You decide what to keep in the next step.
chores.wizard_bathrooms_hint: Each bathroom gets its own chores with their own intervals. The third counts as a guest toilet.
chores.wizard_review_intro: The essentials are already ticked. Tap what you want on top and untick what does not fit. Everything can be changed at any time afterwards.
chores.wizard_added_one: {{count}} chore is in the cleaning plan.
chores.wizard_added_other: {{count}} chores are in the cleaning plan.

todos.title: To do
todos.empty: Nothing to do right now. Add one-off things here, e.g. “Get chicken feed”.
todos.repeat: “{{title}}” comes back: move it to the cleaning plan
todos.repeat_hint: Comes back: pick a room and an interval. This moves the entry from “To do” to the cleaning plan.
todos.need_room: “{{title}}” comes back? The cleaning plan needs a room first.
